# konnect_ai_model (Resource)

AiModel Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_ai_model" "my_aimodel" {
  description  = "Customer support triage model"
  display_name = "My AI Model"
  labels = {
    key = "value"
  }
  name = "my-ai-model"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the AI Model.
- `name` (String) The machine name of the AI Model that uniquely identifies it within the catalog.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optionally provide a description of the AI Model.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels store metadata of an entity that can be used for filtering an entity list or for searching across entity types. 

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the AI Model.
- `managed_by` (Map of String) Stores information about what manages this entity, such as the tool or system responsible for its lifecycle (for example, `terraform`).

Keys must be 1–63 characters long and start with an alphanumeric character.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_ai_model.my_konnect_ai_model
  id = "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_ai_model.my_konnect_ai_model "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
```
